title: Content » Web Page Builder
text:
## Content » Web Page Builder
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047120
A Static Page is a page that does not have any dynamic content. The website only comes with a few default static pages since the majority of the web pages are Dynamic Pages (search result pages, profile pages, and post content).
Some of the most common default Static Pages include:
Homepage - Can only be one Homepage
Login Page
Pricing Page
How It Works
Contact Us Page
Privacy Policy
Terms of Use
Search By Location
Search By Category
Get Matched
Password Retrieval
It is possible to locate the existing Static Pages by going to Content > Web Page Builder:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169316966/original/AkGWMiQ2hvexgxGX3-CGionifyd-ijQ5MA.png?1761061681 | alt: ]

## Edit Existing Pages
To edit the pages, click the Edit button.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169317447/original/y2FEHJLiQLq6-KbiK1P2xad-pkA1B4M4bg.png?1761062076 | alt: ]

## Edit the Homepage
The Homepage cannot be edited through the WebPage Builder; instead, it has a specific section in the Design Settings where it can be managed. To learn how to edit the Homepage, refer to this article:
Homepage » Front & Back End Overview

## Actions Dropdown
To view, clone, or delete an existing static page, hover over Actions and select accordingly:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169317488/original/T5znnb1DAIj8Z5gMuibYmlU1amH65HrsJg.png?1761062122 | alt: ]

## View Page
Redirects the admin to the page on the front end. It shows how members and visitors see the page.

## Clone Page
This action will clone the page exactly how it is. The admin will be required to change the Permalink since two pages cannot have the same one.

## Delete
Click here to permanently delete the page, it cannot be recovered unless a backup is done to the site.

## Keyword Search
Use the search field to search all web pages by keyword.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169317711/original/Hi_CAoLm7Bx0krpGUxkVjL_v3PzzuqvS7g.png?1761062322 | alt: ]

## Sort Options
The Web Page Builder comes with a set of sort options to arrange the pages according to the selected filter.
Sort by:
Page ID Low - High
Page ID High - Low
Name A - Z
Name Z - A
Last Update - Ascending
Last Update - Descending
URL A - Z
URL Z -A
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169317859/original/aszZswirJKeYFpocJjEj9dG7yIQ1VXdt9g.png?1761062457 | alt: ]

## Filter by Access
The Web Page Builder comes with a set of filter by Access options to arrange the pages according to the selected filter.
Filter by Access:
Any Access Level
Public For Everyone
Only Allow Members
Digital Products Buyers
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169318834/original/t8K70QhLguJ6jiwjP0o5IyHrpBSNNu14PQ.png?1761063209 | alt: ]

## Filter by Type
The Web Page Builder comes with a set of filter by Type options to arrange the pages according to the selected filter.
Filter by Type:
Any Page Type
Home Page
Single Web Page
Post Search Results
Member Search Results
Custom Widget as Web Page
Password Retrieval Page
Unsubscribed Page
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169318844/original/65x7-htsw0IS1yWbR7BPYj9j19wK9VI9jQ.png?1761063226 | alt: ]

## Create a New Web Page
To learn how to create a new Static Page, click the link below:
How to Create a New Static Page
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169317570/original/48n7cjOmGee56d6F13VSLmv15wHB80y0Ig.png?1761062200 | alt: ]

## Hide Web Pages
To hide a web page, change the URL to something only the site administrator would know to visit:
/join_DRAFT
This essentially marks the page as " unpublished " from the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169319438/original/J7QAzISXdZCaovPFNvqT4iPfQPD2KAoYog.png?1761063627 | alt: ]
